name: 3D printed NCAS dongle car charger sleeve

mentions.name: 3D printed NCAS dongle car charger sleeve
mentions.description: A 3D printed sleeve that keeps the NCAS dongle secured in the author's car charger, part of the author's practice projects for developing 3D scanning and printing skills.
mentions.problem: The dongle does not stay attached in the car charger; the author wishes a dongle existed that fastened with screws or similar.
mentions.source_excerpt: I want to 3D print a sleeve that keeps the NCAS dongle in my car charger. I really wish there was a dongle that stayed attached with screws or similar.

evidence.value: I want to 3D print a sleeve that keeps the NCAS dongle in my car charger. I really wish there was a dongle that stayed attached with screws or similar.
